createWorkflow.note: Create workflow is a separate expert desk. It does not read or show any aircraft project.
createWorkflow.title: Workflow SOP builder — YESIFU
createWorkflow.lead: You are the master. YESIFU lets you teach this AI apprentice how a job is done. It asks, you explain, it draws the flow as it listens, then it tries one real set of records and you mark the work. When you say it has learned, that becomes an SOP. Each SOP keeps its own conversation, diagram, records, and delivery.
createWorkflow.jobPlaceholder: What is this job called? For example: APU life-limited parts records review
createWorkflow.empty: No SOP yet. Name the first job above to begin.
createWorkflow.firstQuestion: The apprentice is preparing the first question…
createWorkflow.dictateHint: To speak: click the input, press Fn twice to start dictation, then press Fn once to stop

createWorkflow.masterDescription: YESIFU apprentice: learns a job from a master and turns it into an SOP an assistant can follow. Management team only.
createWorkflow.testDescription: Built from a method taught in Create workflow, to check that the new assistant can follow it.

createWorkflow.runHint: What it produced: mark each line Right or Wrong, write the correct answer for the wrong ones, then tell it the review is done

createWorkflow.deliverWait: Tell it “ready to deliver”. It will write the method first.
